changelog:
- Clarified the end-to-end process for converting job-fair role notes and authorized stills into booth talking clips and short animation videos.
- Updated requirements for inputs, file handling, and voice/media rights for each stage of the workflow.
- Detailed new stepwise prompts and actions for recruiters, including clone, speech, and video tasks, with clear confirmation and billing checkpoints.
- Defined safe defaults for animation, voice, and duration, and expanded error handling and recovery procedures.
- Provided explicit routing instructions for non-booth video requests and adjacent use cases.
summary: Turn authorized stills and already-written job-fair role notes into one booth talking clip per still. This campus recruiting talk studio writes a speakable booth talking clip from the role notes, then animates each still into a 2 to 15s job fair video. Use it for recruiting booth video, campus job fair video, and job fair booth talk packs that stay one photo, one clip.
